H1_AX_FULLTREE primary: If <5 families with task-specific product pages captured (<10 valid AX trees 600-2000 nodes) after 3 Docker retries + full-tree grammar + dynamic-token stripping + placeholder fix, then result.status=COMPLETE outcome=NOT_APPLICABLE with H1=MEASUREMENT_INVALID substrate_unavailable (publish failure reasons grammar hash Docker digest). Else if captured >=10 families (20 trees placeholder expanded full-tree without truncation verified product-subtree SHA recomputed after page.content()+AX with dynamic stripping) and mean>=0.6 AND bootstrap CI lower>0.5 AND trajectory-grouped shuffle p<0.05 vs NC1 with +0.20 gap AND delta vs truncated on same pages >=0.20 AND PC1 liveness >=15/20 AND per-family variance>0 (not degenerate [1.0,1.0] homepage tautology) then H1=SURVIVES (full-tree parameterized transfer identifiable within-store). Else if captured >=10 families but mean<0.6 OR CI lower<=0.5 OR p>=0.05 OR delta<0.20 OR variance=0 then H1=FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING bounded to method/families/page-type (does NOT reject alternative grammars or Stagehand/hierarchical retrieval). H2_STAGEHAND_RECOMPUTED: If <30/36 families attempted due to Docker unavailability or SHA not recomputed after mutation with stripping then H2=MEASUREMENT_INVALID. Else if HIT>=0.8 AND MISS>=0.8 AND false_accept<0.05 AND speedup+tokens reported via real path AND beats NC4 p<0.05 AND selectors derived only (0 synthetic fallback) AND recomputed after mutation with dynamic stripping AND PC3 cross-project MISS then H2=SURVIVES. Else if executed >=30 but HIT<0.8 or MISS<0.8 or false_accept>=0.05 or NC4 p>=0.05 then H2=FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING (bounded). H3_WEBGYM_DIVERSE: If <50 WebGym sites then MEASUREMENT_INVALID branch. Else if duplication CI non-overlapping 0.9479 CI OR threshold range>=0.05 then SURVIVES; else if CI overlaps AND range<0.05 then FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING (single-store not distinct). H4_GATE0_RELAXED descriptive: If <5 families >=50 transitions then MEASUREMENT_INVALID Gate0 branch. Else if >=1 relaxed pass (H>0.1 NL>=20 titles>=1 singleton<50%) then SURVIVES pilot feasibility; 0/10 relaxed with adequate NL density then FALSIFIED-IN-SETTING for relaxed pilot on this mix (insufficient density not physics closure). Overall outcome SUPPORTS if H1 and H2 SURVIVE, MIXED if split, FALSIFIES if both falsified, INCONCLUSIVE if H1 MEASUREMENT_INVALID; CAP/LFS exhaustive ABANDONED.
